reply_text:
I sent Tobias three Marrow Fieldworks tickets in your DM. Before the call they should check that all three really belong to this account. In each source the ticket number is filed under "the dealer account," never next to the name Marrow Fieldworks.

- **#4409**: from Moss's digest "Central handoffs next week" (2 Jan 2026). It's a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard. Hollis flagged it as open before the account changed hands on 5 Jan.
- **#4412**: from the same digest. It's a minor glitch in the driver SMS prompt when combine trailers are staged on overflow lots. It was also flagged as open before the handoff.
- **#8841**: from #central-random, Tobias's own message on 13 Oct. West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early.

The digest says Marrow Fieldworks changes hands on 5 Jan, then lists #4409 and #4412 under "Pree's dealer account." The #central-random thread calls it "Tobias's dealer account." I took both to mean Marrow Fieldworks and said so in the reply.

I left out FR-882 (from the same digest) and PD-4821 (from #central-team) because they belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. Moss's Central cheat sheet has no ticket numbers.

I only used channels Tobias is a member of and public files. Nothing in the reply is a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
